nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds per single generation call.

## Links
- [MiniMax H3 on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 (ComfyUI-ready weights)](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)
- [Muse Minimax Director on GitHub](https://github.com/muse-collective-26/MiniMaxH3-Director)
- [MiniMax H3 official prompt-writing guide](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_ref_en.md)

## About this workflow

This workflow runs MiniMax H3's **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task through **Muse Minimax Director**, a timeline-based director node that sits on top of the stock `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. Instead of manually writing `<Picture N>` / `<Video N>` / `<Audio N>` tags into a single prompt box, you build a script visually:

- Drop up to 9 character images into **Ref 1-9** and a **Location** image, write a description for each (or click **Analyze**)
- Write your script as a sequence of **CUTs** along the timeline, and tick who's speaking on each one
- Optionally add reference video and reference audio - Ref Audio N automatically becomes Ref N's voice

Muse Minimax Director compiles all of that into MiniMax H3's own official reference-mode prompt format - six sections (`subject_definitions`, `summary`, `retention_analysis`, `detailed_description`, `overall_soundscape`, `non_diegetic_music`), with every `<Subject N>` / `<Picture N>` / `<Video N>` / `<Audio N>` tag numbered exactly the way H3 itself assigns them, and long scripts automatically split into multiple chunks if they exceed a single ~15 second generation call. Check the node's `compiled_prompt` output any time you want to see exactly what was sent to H3.

**Sampling**: `res_multistep` sampler; `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one.

Full documentation: [github.com/muse-collective-26/MiniMaxH3-Director](https://github.com/muse-collective-26/MiniMaxH3-Director)

- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)

nodes.title: MiniMax Director
widgets_values:
# Muse Minimax Director

## Mode
- **Reference (Omni)** — multi-character/video/audio references, soft-followed
- **First/Last Frame** — Ref 1 = first frame, Ref 2 = last frame, locked exactly

## Generation
- **Total Duration** — the finished length
- **Chunk Size** — length of each single MiniMax call (auto-splits above ~15s)

## Resolution
- **Aspect Ratio / Megapixels** — output size
- **Multiple Of** — leave alone unless you know why you're changing it

## Sampling
- Standard sampler controls
- **Shift (video) / Shift (audio)** — advanced, leave at default

## Reference Settings
- **Ref Image Size** — "match" is faster, "max" is stronger identity but slower
- **Dialogue Language** — feeds every spoken line
- **Hybrid Continuation** — multi-chunk only, needs a First/Last-Frame model wired in

## Overall Style
One or two sentences setting the look of the whole clip — lighting, palette, camera feel.

## Soundscape & Music
- **Overall Soundscape** — ambience/physical sound
- **Non-Diegetic Music** — background score only the audience hears
- Blank or `N/A` if not needed

## Characters / Location
- Drop an image into **Ref 1–9** for each character, **Location** for the setting
- Type a description or click **Analyze**
- **Retention** — how strictly it's followed; leave on `fully preserved` unless intentionally blending

## Ref Video
*(optional)*
- **Subject description** — blank = pure motion/camera reference; fill in if a person/thing should be reused
- **Role** — Reference / Editing source / Continuation source
- **Include this clip's audio** — also pulls its sound in as a voice reference

## Ref Audio
*(optional)*
- A short voice sample + whose voice it is
- **Retention** — `reference` clones the voice/style; `fully copy` reuses the actual audio

## Timeline / CUTs
- One CUT per beat — drag block edges to change pacing
- Put `"quoted text"` in a CUT for dialogue — a **Speaker** dropdown appears

## Referring to things in CUT text
Reference (Omni) — up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio

--- Chunk 1/1 (~10.0s) ---
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is The woman with platinum hair tied back in a high ponytail has pale eyes and a serious expression while standing confidently against a white backdrop, clad in a form-fitting black latex bodysuit accented by glowing cyan seams. (from `<Picture 1>`).
<Subject 2> is The angular black futuristic motorcycle is accentuated by glowing cyan LED lighting running along its wheel rims and body panels. (from `<Picture 2>`).
<Subject 3> is is the misty Stonehenge landscape featuring large standing stones on a grassy plain, referencing the visual style and environment from Asset 3 (right image). (from `<Picture 3>`).

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1>, <Subject 2> and <Subject 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (present throughout): fully_preserved - matches `<Picture 1>`.
<Subject 2> (present throughout): fully_preserved - matches `<Picture 2>`.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - matches `<Picture 3>`.

detailed_description:
The video opens with a wide, cinematic shot of the <Picture 1> landscape under an overcast sky. The scene is misty and atmospheric, with green grass stretching into the distance.
[Shot 1] <Subject 1> (S1) enters the frame from the left, riding <Subject 2> as she accelerates across the open grass, gripping the handlebars and leaning into the turn as she heads toward <Subject 3> in the distance. The camera tracks her from a low angle, emphasizing the wheels churning through the mist.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.333, The camera follows <Subject 1> (S1) as she reaches the standing stones of <Subject 3> and circles them on <Subject 2>, she is riding parallel to the inner ring of monoliths, mist swirling around the base of the stones as she passes. She does a full pass round the whole structure.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.667, A side-profile shot follows <Subject 1> as she completes her loop around the monument on <Subject 2>, her ponytail streaming in the wind, before riding away from the stones and fading into the misty distance.

overall_soundscape:
The motorcycle's engine hums and revs as it moves, tires brushing through wet grass, a soft low wind across the open field.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
